column1: Well partner Keith says, "I guess this means the s#!* has hit the fan."
column2: 「好了，夥伴，」基斯說，「看來事情已經徹底失控了。」

column1: I sure hope Bains lets that correctional officer go unhurt.
column2: 「我真希望班恩斯會放那名矯正員警平安離開。」

column1: Keith says to you...Ole Oak Tree Mall! Boy, do I know that place well. My wife spends half my paycheck there."
column2: 「基斯對你說……『老橡樹購物中心！天啊，我太熟悉那地方了。我老婆一半薪水都花在那裡。』」

column1: Mercy, mercy! Keith says..."We almost had that bulldog for a hood ornament."
column2: 「天啊，天啊！」基斯說……「我們差點就讓那隻鬥牛犬當車頭裝飾了。」

column1: Keith comments..."Can you believe the cars they give us to drive these days? I think I can get better acceleration from my ten-speed bike."
column2: 基斯評論道……「你相信現在配給我們開的車嗎？我覺得我的十段變速腳踏車加速還比較快。」

column1: Keith says to you..."Ok Sonny, I'll give you two-to-one odds for fifty cents that the jogger's a dude... yes or no?"
column2: 基斯對你說……「好，桑尼，我出五十美分，二賠一賭那名慢跑者是男的……你要不要？」

column1: Keith says..."You're on, buddy."
column2: 基斯說……「成交，老兄。」

column1: You little wimp! Keith grunts, disgustedly.
column2: 「你這個小孬種！」基斯厭惡地哼道。

column1: With excitement in his voice, Keith speaks into the mike... "Dispatch...53mary2 with emergency traffic!."
column2: 基斯語氣激動地對麥克風說……「派遣中心……53mary2 有緊急通報！」

column1: Dispatch booms back..."All units hold your traffic...I have emergency traffic from 53mary2..."
column2: 派遣中心大聲回覆……「所有單位暫停通話……53mary2 有緊急通報……」

column1: Dispatch continues..."53mary2, go ahead with your emergency traffic."
column2: 派遣中心繼續說……「53mary2，請報告緊急通報。」

column1: Screaming into the mike Keith says..."Dispatch...53mary2. We have just been ambushed at Cotton Cove by suspect Bains..."
column2: 基斯對著麥克風喊道……「派遣中心……53mary2。我們剛在棉花灣遭嫌犯班恩斯伏擊……」

column1: Continuing..."Suspect last seen northbound on Clearwater Drive at a high rate of speed...Be advised, we do not have him in sight..."
column2: 他繼續說……「嫌犯最後出現在清水大道，正以高速向北行駛……請注意，我們目前看不到他……」

column1: Dispatch acknowledges your traffic. "53mary2... 10-4...Do you have a description of the suspect vehicle?..."
column2: 派遣中心確認你的通報。「53mary2……10-4……你有嫌犯車輛的描述嗎？」

column1: ...and advise injury status from ambush.
column2: 「……並回報伏擊造成的人員受傷情況。」

column1: Almost out of breath, Keith answers..."Dispatch...53mary2... negative injury to personnel..."
column2: 基斯幾乎喘不過氣地回答……「派遣中心……53mary2……人員無受傷……」

column1: ...suspect vehicle matches description of vehicle stolen from Oak Tree Mall.
column2: 「……嫌犯車輛符合從老橡樹購物中心竊取的車輛描述。」

column1: 10-4...Attention all units...per 53mary2...be on the lookout for a stolen 1986 compact black station wagon...
column2: 「10-4……所有單位注意……依 53mary2 通報……留意一輛遭竊的 1986 年黑色小型旅行車……」

column1: Suspect vehicle last seen northbound on Clearwater Drive at a high rate of speed...
column2: 「嫌犯車輛最後出現在清水大道，正以高速向北行駛……」

column1: Break.
column2: 「通話完畢。」

column1: Suspect vehicle has partial plate #C035...Be advised - the driver, Jessie Bains, just ambushed mary2 at Cotton Cove.
column2: 「嫌犯車牌部分號碼為 #C035……請注意——駕駛人傑西．班恩斯剛在棉花灣伏擊 mary2。」

column1: The mary unit has lost sight of vehicle... caution...suspect is armed and dangerous...all units acknowledge.
column2: 「mary 單位已失去車輛蹤跡……注意……嫌犯持有武器且具危險性……所有單位請回覆。」

column1: As other units acknowledge the emergency traffic, Keith says, "We might as well back out of it, Sonny. Looks like we lost the &!*@#*$!"
column2: 其他單位回覆緊急通報時，基斯說：「桑尼，我們不如退出追捕。看來我們跟丟那個 &!*@#*$! 了。」

column1: As other units acknowledge the emergency traffic, Keith says, "We might as well stay here, Sonny. Looks like the &!*@#*$! is loooong gone."
column2: 其他單位回覆緊急通報時，基斯說：「桑尼，我們還是留在這裡吧。看來那個 &!*@#*$! 早就跑遠了。」

column1: Captain Fletcher Hall comes on the air, car-to-car... "53mary2...53mary1 bye."
column2: 弗萊徹．霍爾警監透過車對車無線電加入通話……「53mary2……53mary1 完畢。」
